component.name: Suite Desk
component.summary: Suite Desk, the desktop Suite host

description.p: Suite Desk is the host: one window that opens signed, sandboxed packs as tabs. It owns the chrome, Home and the capability boundary; a pack owns its own document, and the host carries bytes without parsing them.
This is a preview of the host, not the shipping desktop app. Packs and their documents stay on your machine in the app's own data directory: there is no account and no suite-operated server.
